verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a platform rather than an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. Its docs state that every sandbox exposes a built-in MCP server that agents operate via tool calls for files, processes, ports and previews, and a probe confirms an official MCP server documented on the skills-mcp page. Blaxel's MCP Server Hosting (hosting users' own servers) is an adjacent feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detail on the platform-level MCP server's setup, authentication and tool coverage beyond a probe pointer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
